subject.title: feat(talk): expose gateway audio to plugins

question: Should plugins be allowed to observe raw Gateway Talk PCM, and if so what manifest capability and session-ownership rule authorizes that access?
rationale: The patch chooses a durable cross-plugin trust boundary; code review cannot safely infer whether all installed plugins, only declared capabilities, or only session owners should receive raw audio.

options.title: Require an explicit media-observer capability
options.body: Add a manifest/runtime capability and verify session ownership or an explicit grant before delivering any PCM; keep cross-session observation disabled by default.

options.title: Allow trusted global observers
options.body: Retain `scope: "all"` as an intentional privileged plugin contract and document the installation/trust requirement plus its privacy implications.

recommendation.title: Require an explicit media-observer capability
recommendation.body: Add a manifest/runtime capability and verify session ownership or an explicit grant before delivering any PCM; keep cross-session observation disabled by default.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed Talk runtime and follow-up scoping design, so they are best placed to supply the intended contract for maintainer approval.
